_comment: OpenAI fine-tuning configuration for SOAPFlow SOAP note generation
_validation_split: Set to 0.1-0.2 to hold out a validation set
_notes: gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 is recommended for cost-effective fine-tuning
Minimum 10 examples required, 50+ recommended for quality
n_epochs: 3-5 typically sufficient for instruction following tasks
After fine-tuning, update OPENAI_MODEL in backend/.env to the fine-tuned model ID
